messages.content: Reply with one JSON object only, no prose and no code fences. It must match this JSON Schema: {"$defs":{"ParamValue":{"properties":{"name":{"description":"One of the allowed parameter names.","title":"Name","type":"string"},"value":{"title":"Value","type":"number"},"unit":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"title":"Unit"},"variant":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"Variant code the value applies to, or null for all variants.","title":"Variant"},"evidence":{"description":"The exact words from the text that state the value.","title":"Evidence","type":"string"},"page":{"anyOf":[{"type":"integer"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"description":"PDF page number (datasheets only).","title":"Page"}},"required":["name","value","evidence"],"title":"ParamValue","type":"object"}},"properties":{"archetype_guess":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"title":"Archetype Guess"},"keywords":{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":20,"title":"Keywords","type":"array"},"params":{"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/ParamValue"},"maxItems":60,"title":"Params","type":"array"}},"title":"TextExtraction","type":"object"}

Extract product parameters from the product description.

Allowed parameters (name | unit | meaning):
- cells_per_pack | unit | Number of cells in the pack
- capacity_mah | mAh | Rated capacity of the pack
- charge_current_ma | mA | Charge current used in the capacity test
- discharge_current_ma | mA | Discharge current used in the capacity test
- n_screws | unit | Enclosure screws per unit
- n_solder_joints | unit | Pack-to-PCBA solder joints (incl. thermistor)
- n_labels | unit | Labels applied per unit (rating and QR)
- n_leds | unit | Indicator LEDs
- n_ports | unit | Output and input ports
- units_per_carton | unit | Unit boxes per shipper carton

Variants:
- PB10K: Power bank 10,000 mAh
- PB20K: Power bank 20,000 mAh

Rules:
- Use only values the text states. Do not guess or calculate. Skip parameters it does not state.
- "evidence" must copy the exact words from the text that state the value.
- "variant" is the variant code the value applies to, or null when it applies to every variant.
- Give "value" as a plain number in the unit listed for that parameter.
- "archetype_guess" is one of: power_bank, ceiling_fan, generic_electronics, generic_mechanical, or null.
- "keywords": up to 10 words that name the product type and main parts.

TEXT:
Product: Power bank (golden G1)
Category: electronics
Description: Li-ion power bank in two variants built from 21700 cells, a bought BMS + charge PCBA with USB-C and USB-A ports, and a bought PC/ABS moulded enclosure. Cells and PCBA are bought; grading, welding, assembly and test are in-house (ADR-017).
Variant PB10K (Power bank 10,000 mAh). Differences: 2 × 21700 cells, small enclosure, 4 screws
Variant PB20K (Power bank 20,000 mAh). Differences: 4 × 21700 cells, large enclosure, 6 screws
